task_description: Implement M3 Hazard Alerts + M4 Safety Advisor for KlimaGuard PH: a typed mock alerts API route (15-min revalidate), an offline-first useAlerts hook, an always-mounted full-width Alert Red AlertBanner with dismiss/reappear-on-worsening and a 911 button, an EvacuationCard, and a Filipino-first /alerts detail page with always-accessible hotlines. Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TS strict, Tailwind v4.
